title: Funding Assistance for Persons with Disabilities Pursuing University Studies
what_it_is: Funding Assistance for Persons with Disabilities Pursuing University Studies

sections.label: MOE financial assistance schemes
sections.summary: Students needing additional support can use financial assistance schemes such as MOE and Universities bursaries and loans.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Students who need additional support can tap on financial assistance schemes, such as bursaries and loans offered by MOE and the Universities.

sections.label: PSEA and disability support measures
sections.summary: Students can use PSEA balances for degree education, and targeted measures support students with disabilities, including the SkillsFuture Study Award for Persons with Disabilities.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Students can also use the balance in their Post-Secondary Education Account (PSEA) to pay for their degree education.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: Additional targeted measures are available to support students with disabilities in their educational journey.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: For example, the SkillsFuture Study Award for Persons with Disabilities targets persons with disabilities who have at least two years of work experience and demonstrated resilience and perseverance in pursuing learning, skills upgrading and skills deepening.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: The award quantum is up to $5,000 and can be used for Bachelor's degree programmes.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: At the publicly-funded Universities, students with special educational needs may also seek financial assistance to procure assistive technology devices and support services to help them overcome the challenges of actively accessing and participating in classes.

sentences.speaker: The Parliamentary Secretary to the Ministers for Education (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Education (Higher Education and Skills))
sentences.text: While this does not come directly under MOE's purview, I understand that their scholarships are awarded based on merit, and not age.
